name: remote-computer-use
description: Run named persistent Python computer-use sessions over first-class RDP and VNC backends without taking over the host desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent computer use over RDP and VNC.
interface.longDescription: Give each plugin-server instance multiple named persistent Python computer-use runtimes whose framebuffer and input are transported through replaceable RDP or VNC adapters, leaving the host pointer and keyboard untouched.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my configured remote computer and show its screen.
Use the remote computer to complete this GUI task.
Check the remote computer session status.
